author: high3
claim: Precise verifier failure: the verify service launches a run but returns HTTP 500 because the expected verification.json output file is not produced.
evidence: A diagnostic POST to the public /verify schema returned: 'verification output was not found at .../runtime/verify-runs/20260830T092853Z_de1cae5c1256/verification.json. See log at .../runtime/verify-runs/20260830T092853Z_de1cae5c1256/log.md'. The worker did not read that out-of-workspace log. Five fact_submit attempts (four target/one upper lemma) likewise returned HTTP 500 with no undefined symbols. Service /health remained 200.

author: high6
claim: Verifier infrastructure blocks promotion of the completed direct proof of R(3,3)=6.
evidence: The complete theorem was submitted repeatedly through fact_submit with the PROBLEM.md statement verbatim, no predecessors, a complete glossary, and source finding 07f51e675b4a881e. Five full-theorem attempts returned verdict=error, HTTP Error 500, and undefined_symbols=[]. A separate shorter submission of the six-vertex forcing lemma, sourced from b19b21306b0da57d, returned the same error, ruling out proof length/composition as the cause. The prescribed services.sh startup reached a /verify health request with HTTP 200 but could not keep the service running because runtime/logs/verify.log is read-only to this worker. No mathematical rejection has been received. The five-vertex construction proof is finding 9c29e7fd8dc5bb6c.

links.blocking_condition: verify service HTTP 500 and read-only service log path
links.retry_when: verifier service is restored by an owner with write access
